name: Express res.render with user-controlled template name
attack_scenario: attacker sets view=../../../../etc/passwd or points at an attacker-influenced template file, causing the engine to disclose files or evaluate injected template directives
negative_test_hint: request the page with view = "../../../../etc/passwd" and assert the response does not contain file contents or evaluate the path as a template

exemplar.explanation: The first argument to res.render is a template path resolved from the views directory. Letting the request pick it enables local file inclusion and, with a writable template store or a permissive engine, server-side template injection / RCE. Rendering only fixed, developer-chosen template names keeps untrusted input out of path resolution.
